'''Phase 5 Carbon Plating''' was an upgrade [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] could purchase for their vehicles to reinforce their Podracer's durability, adding [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] based plating to the vehicle. The upgrade cost anywhere from 950 to 1,200 [[Trugut/Legends|truguts]].<ref name="Guide" /> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="RR2" /> the junk [[Merchant/Legends|dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] sold this upgrade to [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer pilots]].<ref name="RR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phase 5 Carbon Plating was first mentioned in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', and was available as a Podracer upgrade that players could purchase. The plating was never visible to the player.<ref name="RR" /> The upgrade was mentioned again in the game's [[Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]].<ref name="Guide" />
